units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 1:2:3">Y. Gitt. I, 43ᶜ</cite> top <he>עֲרָרוֹ בטל</he>, v. <cite ref="P01454"><he>עָרַר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 9:1:2">Y. Keth. IX, beg. 32ᵈ</cite> <he>כל ע׳ שיש לי בשדה זו</he> whatever claim I may have on this field.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 3:1:10">Y. R. Hash. III, 58ᵈ</cite> top <he>קרא ע׳ על וכ׳</he> if objection was raised against the signature &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 1:2:3">Y. Gitt. I, 43ᶜ</cite> bot <he>ע׳ שבגיפו</he> an objection based on an alleged informality of the document itself; <he>ע׳ שחוץ לגופו</he> an objection not concerning the document itself (e.g. that the letter of divorce was given conditionally).
